sentence: Ice hockey, three against three: skaters, a puck, two goals, first to three goals wins. I play one skater with WASD and shoot with space.
title: Ice hockey, three against three

brief.rules: Three skaters a side, one puck, two goals. First to three goals wins.
brief.arena: An ice rink 60 m by 30 m with boards and two goals.
brief.ai: Two blue teammates and three red opponents chase, pass and shoot.
brief.controls: WASD moves the player's skater (blue b0), space shoots.
brief.mood: Bright arena light, clean ice, two team colours.

packages.title: Rink, puck, skaters, goals and the rule
packages.contract:
scripts/main.gd: the entry script; builds the rink from data/venue.json, six skaters, the puck and two goals; first to rules.score_to_win goals wins.
data/tuning.json: rules.score_to_win, skater.skate_speed, shoot.speed, puck.radius, puck.height, puck.color, camera.pos, camera.fov.
scripts/rink_api.gd: puck_pos(), skater_pos(team, i), nearest_to_puck(team), set_ai(callable).
Input actions: move_up, move_down, move_left, move_right, shoot. The player is skater b0 of the blue team.
PLAYER CHECK: tests/bot_hockey.gd fails when the player's skater b0 took no shot or the blue team lost; it drives b0 through the input actions.

packages.title: Teammates and opponents
packages.contract:
scripts/ai/brain.gd: decide(team, i, api) -> {move: Vector2, shoot: bool} for the five skaters the player does not control.
data/ai.json: red_skill (0..1), chase_radius_m, yield_radius_m.
tests/bot_hockey_ai.gd: with the player idle, both AI teams reach the puck and at least one goal falls.

packages.title: Stands, markings, light
packages.contract: gen/art_hook.gd adds the stands, the rink markings and the light masts from kit parts listed in data/venue_art.json; the view `arena` shows them.

packages.title: Sounds and goal effects
packages.contract: scripts/fx/fx.gd plays a horn and a burst at the goal on rules' `goal` event; volumes and sizes in data/fx.json.
